frozen_note: Pre-registered before any mist-model-bench data exists (T3b). Committed as its own change, before analyse.py, so history shows the rules fixed before the analysis code and before a single result lands. A threshold here is never edited to change a verdict on data already collected; a genuine recalibration is a new commit with its own rationale, not an amendment to this one.

margin_definitions.clear: the bootstrap 95% CI for the clause's metric lies entirely on one side of the threshold
margin_definitions.within-noise: the bootstrap 95% CI for the clause's metric straddles the threshold
margin_definitions.n/a: the clause is not a proportion (decode_tps, p95 wall time, VRAM fit): no bootstrap CI is computed for it

layout_acc.definition: Proportion of correct == true over rows with phase == 'accuracy'. correct == false, parse failures, and errored rows all count as incorrect. n_expected is 72 for the screen pass and 216 for the finalist pass (constants.layout_n_expected). Coverage below n_expected makes the metric incomplete: it is never computed on a partial set for a verdict, only reported for information with its actual coverage.

layout_mean_completion_tokens.definition: Mean of usage.completion_tokens over all accuracy-phase rows (same denominator as layout_acc, not just correct ones). completion_tokens_per_correct (total completion tokens over accuracy rows / n_correct) is reported alongside as information only, not used in any clause.

layout_p95_wall_ms.definition: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of wall_ms over all accuracy-phase rows for the arm at its own thinking setting -- end to end per layout call.

harness_score.source: scripts.eval_harness.scorers.score_run(jsonl_paths=[<results>/<arm>/harness/harness/<candidate>.jsonl], test_files=run.load_test_files([test_name], tests_dir)), TestScores.mean_score for the named test_name
harness_score.definition: score_run does not exclude records with error set: _ingest_record appends a CaseScore with score=0.0, passed=False, examined=None for every errored record (scripts/eval_harness/scorers.py, the `if record.get('error')` branch in _ingest_record), so an HTTP 500 already contributes a 0 to mean_score once its line is present in the JSONL. That leaves one gap score_run cannot see: a case-iteration whose line was never written at all (run_candidate stopped early and the harness still exited 0). Coverage is therefore checked independently here as len(case_scores) for the test against cases_expected * iterations_expected (from meta.json's harness.tests case count via run.load_test_files, and harness.iterations). A test with coverage below the expected count is incomplete: harness_score is never computed on it for a verdict, only reported with its actual coverage.

truncation_rate.definition: Fraction of records for (arm, test_name) with finish_reason == 'length', over all records present (same coverage rule as harness_score: incomplete coverage is reported but not used for a verdict).

decode_tps.definition: Median of predicted_per_second over rows with ctx_target == constants.ttft_ctx_target, warmup == false, and error == null. Requires at least constants.min_ttft_rows matching rows; fewer is missing.

ttft_ms.definition: Median of ttft_ms over the same filter as decode_tps, reported per ctx_target present in the file. Information only, feeds no clause.

arm_peak_mib.definition: Max of memory_used_mib over all rows for the arm. Includes the desktop baseline, since the production backend is stopped during bench runs.

voice_vram_lower_mib.definition: backend_idle.median_mib - mist_llm.median_mib. A lower bound on STT+TTS VRAM footprint.

voice_vram_upper_mib.definition: voice_peak.max_mib - mist_llm.median_mib. An upper bound: the voice probe double-counts VRAM the backend already holds resident at startup (README 'Double-counting note'), so this overstates VRAM pressure rather than understating it.

total_mib.definition: GPU total memory as reported by nvidia-smi at any sampled step (constant across steps on one host).

rules.question: Does the current Gemma 4 E4B model, run with a 512-token thinking budget, clear the layout accuracy bar to stay in production?

informational.note: c1-256 is reported alongside c1-512 for information only; it feeds no clause.

rules.question: Should MIST switch from Gemma 4 E4B to c2 (12B dense QAT)?
Should MIST switch from Gemma 4 E4B to c3 (26B-A4B MoE)?
Should MIST switch from Gemma 4 E4B to c4 (Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MoE)?
Is c3's MoE output truncated often enough under the production json_object arm to drop the MoE candidates?

informational.note: Grammar-constrained truncation on c3, reported for comparison against the json_object arm. Feeds no clause.

rules.question: Is thinking mode a large enough lever on layout accuracy at c2 to be load-bearing for the model decision?
Does the voice VRAM footprint justify moving the GTX 1070 up in priority?

clauses.note: Triggered requires: voice_vram_lower_bound holds AND at least one R2 candidate (c2, c3, or c4) has every other R2 clause (L, S1, S2, D, P) verdict pass, with F verdict fail or needs-review. needs-review (not triggered) if only voice_vram_upper_mib >= r5_voice_vram_upper_needs_review_mib, i.e. the lower bound does not clear the trigger threshold but the upper (conservative) estimate does.
